notes: Minister Billy Wilson is described as a graduate of the British Bible College who preached 15 years in Glasgow. Sermons are published both on the site and as a podcast, so a text corpus is obtainable. Street address not confirmed. Note there are several similarly named Churches of Christ in Tucson (Country Club Road, Christ's Church of Tucson, Iglesia de Cristo) - keep them separate.
